generalized_rule: A product's public identity, runtime defaults, IDE defaults, package metadata, persistent agent instructions, submission claims, and proof language must describe the same operational boundary. An optional capability must not be presented or configured as a default dependency. Clean configuration must remain fail-closed, while explicit user opt-in and explicitly selected dormant routes remain preserved without gaining authority.

an explicitly selected provider remains visible as dormant configuration without becoming final authority
preferred mode falls back to the complete model-free formation while required mode remains an explicit strict gate
